name: tcan-claude-mods
description: Claude Code 小工具合輯：TCAN 主題、罐罐像素動畫、額度、使用時間、資料夾標籤。Claude Code mods: TCAN theme, CAN pixel animations, usage limits, time spent, folder label.

plugins.name: tcan-theme
plugins.description: TCAN 台灣氣候行動網絡配色主題：TCAN 藍、深藍與暖化紅，固定淺色。A Taiwan Climate Action Network (TCAN) color theme: TCAN blue, navy and warming red, light mode.

plugins.name: guanguan-pixel
plugins.description: TCAN 吉祥物「罐罐」像素動畫：工作中踏步、每日招呼、做完事眨眼、提到 TCAN 跳出圖示、跑太久地球轉一下。Pixel animations of CAN, the TCAN mascot: marches while Claude works, says hi once a day, winks when done.

plugins.name: usage-meter
plugins.description: 輸入框右上方的按鈕：5 小時／7 天額度還剩多少、何時重置、每天用量月曆（TCAN 配色）。A button above the prompt box: how much of your 5-hour / 7-day limits is left, when they reset, and a daily-usage calendar.

plugins.name: usage-time
plugins.description: 記錄你使用 Claude Code 的時間：今天、本週每天、本週各資料夾。Tracks time spent in Claude Code: today, each day this week, and this week by folder.

plugins.name: folder-label
plugins.description: 在輸入框上方左邊顯示「❐ 資料夾名稱」。Shows ❐ and the current folder's name above the prompt box, on the left.
